text: 2026-08-01 முதல் 2026-08-31 வரை EMI orders-க்கு சராசரி settlement lag: Anchor Acquiring 2.972618700844742 days, Cobalt Processing 2.0 days, Meridian Acquiring 1.5037270642201834 days, Northgate Payments 2.824343506032647 days, Solstice Merchant Services 3.4982778415614235 days.
